# spare-token-bug-fixes

> Research pages and reflections and free bug fixes that an AI chatbot (Claude) wrote for the repository author. Every file is public and may be downloaded for research. The repository author says anyone may use and copy and share the writing without asking. No other person has rechecked the pages.

## Download everything

- [Zip of the whole repository](https://github.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/archive/refs/heads/main.zip): one download that holds every file
- [Every reading page in one text file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/boring-things/download-everything/research-pages-all-in-one.txt): 250 pages joined into one plain text file
- [List of every file as JSON](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/boring-things/download-everything/file-list.json): path and title and size and direct download address for 1226 files
- [List of direct download addresses](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/boring-things/download-everything/file-list.txt): one address per line
- Any single file: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chmillera-hub/spare-token-bug-fixes/main/<path of the file>
